verdict.rationale: Evidence directly shows Latham advises both startups and venture/institutional investors across financing structures (supp-investor-side, supp-seed-financing, supp-deal-volume), indicating dual-side market knowledge, and the Book of Jargon/LathamDrive resources reflect codified market-terms knowledge used across deals. Missing for 10: explicit description of a dedicated fund-formation/VC-side practice group or named investor-side deal examples, and independent third-party confirmation of cross-market-term expertise beyond firm's own marketing pages.
